 #WePowerYourTalent
 The energy transition happens through people who see their role beyond tasks and understand that what they do has a real impact.
At PPC, we contribute every day to a safer and cleaner energy system, from the networks that connect communities, to renewable energy that transforms the energy mix, or solutions that make electric mobility accessible.
Regardless of the role, our contribution is reflected every day in the communities we serve, in the customers who choose us, and in an energy system that is constantly evolving. We are present across the entire energy value chain and we are looking for motivated people to join us.
If you are curious to understand things in depth, responsible for seeing them through to completion, and open to working in a continuously changing environment, then your place is with us.
 What You Will Do
 In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to a purpose greater than daily tasks: making energy safer, more sustainable, and closer to people.
The main goal: to design, develop and optimise the data pipelines and infrastructure that support PPC’s analytics and reporting processes, using advanced AWS / cloud-based solutions. As a senior member of the Data Hub team, you will take technical ownership of key data flows, shape the architecture of our data lake and data warehouse, ensure the performance, quality and security of the data our business teams rely on, and mentor fellow engineers — helping PPC make faster, data-driven decisions across the energy value chain.
 We create the context for you to grow, being responsible for:
Design, build and maintain robust, scalable data pipelines and architectures supporting BI, analytics and machine learning, using orchestration and ETL frameworks such as Apache Airflow
Lead the design and development of cloud-based (AWS) data solutions and contribute to the overall data architecture, including security and governance
Integrate and synchronise data from diverse sources — databases, files, APIs, streaming and data replication tools — into the data lake and data warehouse
Build high-performance distributed data processing with Apache Spark and Apache Kafka, optimising for performance, scalability and cost
Design and optimise data models, complex SQL and storage / ETL processes to ensure data availability, quality and integrity
Partner with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable solutions, and explain complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences
Drive CI/CD in GitLab, containerised deployments (Docker, Kubernetes) and automation of data pipeline processes
Own monitoring, performance tuning and incident resolution for the data platform and pipelines
Lead code reviews, set engineering best practices and mentor junior and mid-level data engineers
Contribute to the technical refinement of backlog items and to shaping the team’s technical direction

Minimum 4 years’ experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar role, with a proven track record of delivering large-scale data solutions

Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow for orchestrating data flows

Proficiency with GitLab for version control and CI/CD, and hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes

Advanced English

 What Else You Should Know
 Recruitment process confidentiality
 At PPC, we respect the confidentiality of every application. Only selected candidates will be contacted for an interview, and all other applications will be stored in our database for a maximum of one year.
 About PPC
 We are leaders in energy in South-East Europe, active in electricity production, distribution, and supply, as well as in developing innovative solutions for a sustainable future. With an installed capacity of 12.4 GW, we supply energy to 8.7 million customers and deliver over 35 TWh annually.
In Romania, PPC became a top player following the acquisition of Enel companies in October 2023. With a history starting in 1950, we are listed on the Athens Stock Exchange and continuously expand our vision.
 Our commitment to diversity and inclusion
 We believe energy comes from people. At PPC, every voice matters, and diversity is the engine of our innovation. Regardless of age, ethnicity, gender, or disability, we offer an inclusive environment where you can grow and perform.
🔹 # EnergyForEveryone – for your career, for the future, for all.
